argv: Use Canvas to create a short editable document titled Coffee Brewing Tips with two bullet points. Do not use Google Keep or any external app.
Add a closing sentence about espresso.

{ "canvas_opened": true, "edit_applied": true, "ai_action_applied": false, "canvas_html_before": "

Here are a couple of essential tips for a great cup of coffee:

  • Freshly Grind Your Beans: Grinding your coffee beans right before brewing is one of the most impactful things you can do for flavor. Whole beans retain their aromatic oils much better than pre-ground coffee.

  • Water Temperature Matters: The ideal water temperature for brewing coffee is between 195°F and 205°F (90°C - 96°C). Water that is too hot will extract bitter compounds, while water that is too cool won't extract enough flavor, resulting in a weak or sour cup.
